name: Tiny Dungeon ~BLACK and WHITE~
source:
The young heroes from the demon, god, dragon and human worlds meet at the Trinity school to hone their skills. There was a world-destroying war 25 years ago caused by human greed. Now, one young man has a vision of the past human hero who tells him that the future is in his hands. Which future will he choose: Vell of the demon world, Note of the god world or Ururu of the dragon world?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
来自魔界、神界、龙界与人界的年轻英杰齐聚Trinity学园，磨炼各自的本领。25年前，人类的贪婪引发了一场毁灭世界的战争。如今，一名青年看见了过去人类英雄的幻象，对方告诉他，未来掌握在他的手中。他会选择怎样的未来：魔界的贝尔、神界的诺特，还是龙界的乌璐璐？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
